name: iMac 24" M1 (2021)
ports: 2× Thunderbolt/USB 4, 2× USB 3 (4-port models), Gigabit Ethernet on power brick (4-port)
colours: Blue, Green, Pink, Silver, Yellow, Orange, Purple
commonIssues: Internal backup battery swelling (rare but documented)
Soldered SSD failure - chip-off recovery required
Power supply / power-brick failure
Magic Keyboard / Touch ID pairing issues after macOS updates
Webcam ribbon cable wear from screen open/close during repair attempts
USB-C port wear from heavy dongle use
timelineNotes: Logic-board work 3-5 days. Power supply same-day to 2 days. Screen 3 days (panel sourced).
honestyNote: First M-series iMac and still a great machine in 2026. RAM and SSD are soldered - what you bought is what you keep. Logic-board failures we handle component-level where possible; full-board swap is the fallback.
heroTagline: First Apple Silicon iMac. Seven colours, 4.5K Retina, M1 - and we still keep these in great shape.

name: iMac 24" M3 (2023)
ports: 2× Thunderbolt/USB 4, 2× USB 3 (4-port), Gigabit Ethernet on power brick (4-port)
colours: Blue, Green, Pink, Silver, Yellow, Orange, Purple
commonIssues: 8GB base RAM bottleneck - heavy macOS swap usage stresses the SSD
Soldered SSD failure on heavily-swapped 8GB units
Power-brick failure (shared design with M1)
Webcam ribbon cable wear
Touch ID Magic Keyboard pairing issues
timelineNotes: Most repairs 2-4 days. Apple SKIPPED M2 for iMac entirely - the M3 was the direct successor to M1.
honestyNote: Apple skipped the M2 iMac generation entirely. If you have an 8GB M3, treat the SSD with care - heavy macOS swap usage on the soldered drive shortens its life. We've seen a few of these come in for chip-off SSD recovery already.
heroTagline: Apple skipped M2 - this was the M1's direct successor. Same 7 colours, more punch.

name: iMac 24" M4 (2024)
chip: Apple M4 (8 or 10-core CPU, 8 or 10-core GPU)
ports: 2× Thunderbolt 4, 2× USB-C (4-port), Gigabit Ethernet on power brick (4-port)
colours: Blue, Green, Pink, Silver, Yellow, Orange, Purple (refreshed shades)
commonIssues: Accidental damage during moves (24" panel cracks)
Power-brick port wear
12MP Centre Stage camera ribbon issues (rare)
Touch ID keyboard pairing after major macOS updates
Nano-texture display surface scratches if cleaned with the wrong cloth
timelineNotes: Apple's current 24" iMac. Most parts via authorised channels - battery-style same-day for power brick, 3 days for logic board.
honestyNote: Current Apple lineup - always check warranty / AppleCare+ first. We handle accidental damage Apple won't cover (cracked panel, liquid spill, dropped power brick).
heroTagline: Apple's current 24" iMac. 12MP camera, M4 punch, nano-texture option.

name: iMac 27" 2017
chip: Intel Core i5 / i7 (7th gen Kaby Lake)
commonIssues: Power supply failure (very common across 2017-2020 27" line)
Radeon Pro GPU artefacts / failures
Fusion Drive HDD failure (the spinning disk dies first)
Thermal paste degradation - fans run loud
Glass adhesive failure after repair attempts (we use proper adhesive strips)
timelineNotes: RAM upgrade same-day. Fusion → SSD swap 1-2 days (one of our most-requested jobs). Logic-board work 3-5 days.
honestyNote: Pre-T2 chip - much more user-serviceable than later models. RAM is socketed and upgradeable to 64GB. The single biggest speed boost we can give you is replacing the Fusion Drive with a proper SSD. Customers tell us their 2017 iMac feels brand new after this.
heroTagline: 5K Retina, upgradeable RAM, no T2 chip. Still a fantastic machine in 2026 - and we keep it that way.

name: iMac 27" 2019
chip: Intel Core i5 / i7 / i9 (9th gen Coffee Lake Refresh - up to 8 cores)
commonIssues: Power supply failure (very common)
Radeon Pro Vega GPU thermal failures
Fusion Drive HDD failure
Thermal paste degradation - high i9 temperatures
Loud fans under sustained load
timelineNotes: RAM upgrade to 64GB same-day. Fusion → SSD 1-2 days. Power supply 1-2 days. Last macOS support: Sonoma 14.
honestyNote: The best Intel 27" iMac for upgrade value. i9 + 64GB RAM + 2TB SSD is a beast for ~AED 3,250 in upgrades - beats a base M4 Mac mini for display and total RAM. If you own one, upgrade it before buying new.
heroTagline: i9, 64GB capable, 5K Retina. The best Intel 27" iMac to upgrade in 2026.

name: iMac 27" 2020 (last Intel)
chip: Intel Core i5 / i7 / i9 (10th gen Comet Lake - up to 10 cores), T2 security chip
commonIssues: Power supply failure (carries over from 2017-2019)
T2 chip activation lock issues after logic-board changes
Nano-texture display surface scratches from incorrect cleaning
Thermal paste degradation on i9 / 10-core variants
10GbE port failures (option)
SSD failure (now soldered behind T2 - chip-off recovery required)
timelineNotes: RAM upgrade same-day to 128GB. T2 chip means SSD is soldered - no SSD upgrade possible. Power supply 1-2 days. Last Intel iMac Apple ever made.
honestyNote: Last Intel iMac ever, and the best one. RAM goes to 128GB user-upgradeable - incredible. But the T2 chip soldered the SSD to the board, so SSD upgrades are impossible (and SSD failure means chip-off recovery). Still receives the latest macOS Sequoia 15. Excellent buy used.
heroTagline: Last Intel iMac. 128GB RAM-capable, T2-secured, still on macOS Sequoia in 2026.

name: iMac Pro 27" (2017)
chip: Intel Xeon W (8 / 10 / 14 / 18 cores), T2 security chip
commonIssues: Radeon Pro Vega 56/64 GPU module failures
Thermal paste degradation under Xeon load
Power supply failure
Parts scarcity - Xeon CPUs and Vega GPU modules are rare in 2026
T2 SSD failure - chip-off recovery only
timelineNotes: Parts sourcing 3-7 days for Xeon CPUs and Vega GPU modules - these are rare. Standard repairs (PSU, thermal paste, RAM) 2-3 days.
honestyNote: Discontinued in 2021 and parts are getting genuinely rare. Xeon CPUs and Vega GPU modules can take a week to source. We're honest at intake - if it's a GPU failure on a 2017 iMac Pro, the parts may exceed the resale value. PSU and thermal jobs are still very worthwhile.
heroTagline: Xeon W, ECC RAM, Vega Pro graphics, Space Gray. The workstation iMac. We still service them - when parts are available.
